==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Meet the Vabbian nobles in [[Zehlon Reach]].
* Escort the Vabbian nobles on their tour of the [[Zehlon Reach]].
* See [[Clerk Arlon]] for your reward. 

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{x}} 10 [[Nobleman Emrah]]
*{{x}} 10 [[Vabbian Noble]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Clerk Arlon'''
:''"Now that I know I can trust you to handle a task, I have a job to offer you.  It's cushy and pays well.  I can see you are interested.  All you need to do is escort a small group of Vabbian noblemen on a hike through [[Zehlon Reach]].  They absolutely insist on taking a closer look at the "real Istani countryside" no matter how dangerous I tell them the area can be.  Accompany them on their little expedition and I'll reward you handsomely."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Sounds like a deal.
|decline = I'm no tour guide, and stop calling me 'Handsomely.'
|ask = The Vabbians eagerly await you in [[Zehlon Reach]].  Let them have their fun, but bring them home alive at the end of the day. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Nobleman Emrah'''
:''"Wow, real Sunspears!  This will be a real treat for us all.  Shall we get started?"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Clerk Arlon'''
:''"Very nice.  You thoroughly impressed those Vabbian nobles.  I wouldn't be surprised if they asked for your assistance again."''

==Trivia==
*The decline dialogue may possibly be a reference to a joke made in the film [[w:Airplane!|Airplane!]].
*Before the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110728|July 28, 2011 update]], the NPCs having the appearance of [[Vabbian Noble]]s and the quest dialogue claiming them to be Vabbian Nobles, the NPCs involved in this quest were given the name "[[Istani Noble]]".
